// @path: src/lib/ops/reads.ts
// @expect: OPS-CHILD-SCOPE-KEY
// R10 refuses classId as a groupBy key. This is the same number by a different
// route, and in a class of one it names that child.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function pupilsInClass(classId) {
  return db.student.count({ where: { classId } });
}
